import cv2
import numpy as np

def ray_ground(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, heading_deg):
    z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256) / 256)
    x_c = (u - 256) / 256 * z_c
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    wx = cam_x + z_c * np.sin(theta) + x_c * np.cos(theta)
    wy = cam_y + z_c * np.cos(theta) - x_c * np.sin(theta)
    return wx, wy, z_c

# In obs_0075: cam at (2.28, 1.87), heading = 270 deg (-x)
img75 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0075.png')

# 1. Plant pot:
mask_pot = (img75[:,:,2] > 120) & (img75[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 300)
yp, xp = np.where(mask_pot)
u_pot = (xp[yp == yp.max()].min() + xp[yp == yp.max()].max()) / 2
v_pot = yp.max()
wx_p, wy_p, z_p = ray_ground(u_pot, v_pot, 2.28, 1.87, 270)
print(f'Plant pot in obs_0075: pixel=({u_pot:.1f}, {v_pot}) -> world=({wx_p:.2f}, {wy_p:.2f}), dist={z_p:.2f}')

# 2. Blue vase / cylinder:
mask_vase = (img75[:,:,0] > 150) & (img75[:,:,2] < 50)
yv, xv = np.where(mask_vase)
u_vase = (xv[yv == yv.max()].min() + xv[yv == yv.max()].max()) / 2
v_vase = yv.max()
wx_v, wy_v, z_v = ray_ground(u_vase, v_vase, 2.28, 1.87, 270)
print(f'Blue vase in obs_0075: pixel=({u_vase:.1f}, {v_vase}) -> world=({wx_v:.2f}, {wy_v:.2f}), dist={z_v:.2f}')

# 3. Armchair / sofa:
mask_sofa = (img75[:,:,0] > 90) & (img75[:,:,0] < 140) & (img75[:,:,1] > 90) & (img75[:,:,1] < 140) & (img75[:,:,2] > 90) & (img75[:,:,2] < 140) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 350)
ys, xs = np.where(mask_sofa)
# Armchair base touching floor:
u_sofa = (xs[ys == ys.max()].min() + xs[ys == ys.max()].max()) / 2
v_sofa = ys.max()
wx_s, wy_s, z_s = ray_ground(u_sofa, v_sofa, 2.28, 1.87, 270)
print(f'Sofa in obs_0075: pixel=({u_sofa:.1f}, {v_sofa}) -> world=({wx_s:.2f}, {wy_s:.2f}), dist={z_s:.2f}')

# 4. Chair (near the sofa, brown):
mask_chair = (img75[:,:,2] > 80) & (img75[:,:,2] < 150) & (img75[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 400)
yc, xc = np.where(mask_chair)
u_chair = (xc[yc == yc.max()].min() + xc[yc == yc.max()].max()) / 2
v_chair = yc.max()
wx_c, wy_c, z_c = ray_ground(u_chair, v_chair, 2.28, 1.87, 270)
print(f'Chair leg in obs_0075: pixel=({u_chair:.1f}, {v_chair}) -> world=({wx_c:.2f}, {wy_c:.2f}), dist={z_c:.2f}')
"", "description": "Triangulate plant, vase, sofa, and chair from obs_0075"}
